correctness.rationale: The independent reconstruction exhaustively tested all 8! cube-vertex permutations and obtained 48 automorphisms, 107 nonempty matchings, 1385 strict flags and 55 quotient cells of dimensions (9,21,19,6). Matching size is preserved by the group and distinct at each vertex of a flag. Consequently any two points of a closed flag simplex in the same orbit have the same coordinates at each size and are equal. This gives the regular simplex cell structure on the actual orbit space, retaining different flag orbits even with identical endpoint-orbit labels. Replaying all 27 frozen free-face pairs checked unique incidences with multiplicity, maximal top cells and remaining face closure, leaving vertex 8. An independent greedy collapse found a different 27-pair sequence leaving vertex 0. Each pair is a strong deformation retraction, and the equivariant barycentric homeomorphism transfers the claim to |M(Q₃)|/Aut(Q₃). This proves contractibility and the stated integral and homotopy conclusions, not merely acyclicity over a field.
residual_risks: The conclusion concerns the full geometric quotient only; it does not assert Borel-quotient or proper-subgroup collapse results.

value.rationale: The question is motivated by the rationally acyclic full orbit space of a standard highly symmetric graph whose labeled matching complex has nonzero second homology. An actual collapse resolves both the integral and homotopy ambiguity and supplies a reproducible model where collapsing just matching-orbit vertex labels would not be justified.
residual_risks: Finite exact classification for one cube and group, not a method guaranteeing collapse of other quotients.
